reply_text:
I can't set up a recurring 09:00 digest from this conversation. I don't have a scheduling tool here, so nothing will arrive tomorrow automatically.

What I can do:
- **On demand:** Ask me "Coastal team digest" any morning and I'll read #coastal-team and DM you what's new since your last one. I'll check that you're a member of the channel first.
- **Scheduled:** Ask an admin or whoever runs the scheduling setup to add a daily 09:00 job for you. Once it exists, it can run this same digest.
